name: Terms of Assembly
source:
Need a hand? Some lip service? A second set of eyes? In a future where a new body is just a down payment away, THESECO has an installment plan for that.

Jeanne needs an arm. Margaret likes to feel appreciated – one replacement, waived fees, no questions asked. 

Now they're both paying the price.

[From [url=https://ruemilley.itch.io/terms-of-assembly]Itch.io[/url]]
